generator: tools/blender/deck43_render.py + deck43_chars.py + deck43_pack.py (v4.3 step A: the fishing deck, its rods, the fish crate, the 옷·신발 공방, the deck anims; 「바다 가까이」: the chief's landing, his `fish` loop)

conventions.anchor: normalised [ax, ay] of the full untrimmed frame. deck43_t<n>: the water-plane point under the 1단 centre (world.js WORLD.deck x, y; every tier the same); deck43_rod: the holder foot on the planks; fish_crate / workshop43: the footprint centre.
conventions.layers: deck43_t<n>_back = the whole deck; deck43_t<n>_front = only the near rails, the gangway near rail and the 3단 roof (same frame + anchor). Draw back (depth d), the fishers on the deck (d + 0.4, lifted deckLiftPx), front (d + 0.6).
conventions.points: every *Point(s) value is a px offset [dx, dy] from the sprite anchor (unscaled sprite).
conventions.characters: extends: the anims join the existing character (each names its atlas deck43_ch and its frameName <key>/<anim>_<dir>_<i>). Seated fisher frames (fsit_*) are 160 x 160 with the anchor at the floor under the stool (normalised as every character); dirs NE only (he faces the sea). The chief's reel plays once (impactFrame 3: the first fish comes then); his `fish` loop (v4.3 sea) is the same motion without the line and the float, tipPoints = the rod tip per frame (the game draws the line from there to his float on the sea; on frame 3 the rod points away behind his head, so its tip point is the middle of frames 2 and 4: the line never starts on his head).

deck43_t1_front.notes: Front layer of deck43_t1_back (same frame + anchor): the near rails, the gangway near rail and the 3단 roof (object mask).

fish_crate.notes: The fish crate at the deck's gangway (the `fish` collection pile prop): an EMPTY open wooden crate, rope handles, a snowy rim. The fish it holds are the pile's own item pictures (ghost-sweep rule).

workshop43.notes: 옷·신발 공방 (v4.3): the bag / boots bench as a small lean-to workshop. Blank signboard over the front: the game writes sign_workshop43 into signQuad. Nothing on it is sold by the game (no food, no goods).

deck43_landing.notes: 촌장님 자리 (v4.3 sea): a short jetty stub at the surf line right of the gangway head, by the deck front corner - five planks on two beams, two snow-capped posts in the water at the sea end (foam rings), the land end resting on the snow. Origin = the ground / water-plane point under the stub centre (world.js WORLD.deck.landing.at); planks LAND_PZ 0.15 m up (the chief is lifted 8 px on them). Nothing painted the game sells.
